display_name: 学习地面先验和盲信道一致性交替恢复原型
description: 从干净地面源 IQ 学习带噪声条件的信号去噪先验，推理时与冻结盲信道估计和数据一致性算子交替。
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 GPU2 source-only clean-IQ denoiser training; CPU 2 threads; TF32 disabled; independent real source training and inference preflights

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: IQ [2,256], learned clean source denoising prior, frozen blind action and Gaussian posterior initialization with data-consistency prox
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: No TX labels or U_s truth loaded in either training or evaluation
data.validation_ref: 384 fixed RX8 source heldout IDs, 64 per impaired scene, previously explored; no true-label evaluation
data.leo_config_ref: Clean IQ source denoising training; source cache epoch19 evaluation

permissions.query_use: Source training ground IQ and frozen classifier outputs only; no TX labels, U_s truth, V or test
permissions.claim_scope: Source physical IDs observed in previous channel views, RX8 same prior pilot; no independent blind or real satellite claim

checkpoint.initialization: Random learned ground denoiser identity initialized; F frozen. Blind action checkpoint and source prior loaded only after training; DURA comparison only.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact blind action sha256 0ef60a205f785bda45f9936d519e925179dbbddeef2fd6cd285a83b02a284338; source prior sha256 5e35516d54d3e3d1d1749933861f290c1f87c8ffdb4b863d2f9819914135ceb9
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: Three fixed clean-IQ source epochs, epoch3 weights; 3 fixed proximal strengths .1,1,10 and fixed RX8 384 source diagnostic. No automatic Phase1 test.

execution.gpu_policy: GPU2 single owner, TF32 disabled, source-only training; real L_s/U_s gradient preflight

metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Source F pseudo targets not truth, source IDs previously observed in other views, no target test.

rows.budget_ref: 4096 clean source IDs, three epochs, batch16; three proximal steps and three fixed strengths
